_comment: Add 2026-09-05 — KimlyParc Original Korean Latte, at Ryan's request. Weight from the maker's product page ('10Packets x 0.7oz (20g)'); calories transcribed from the Nutrition Facts panel image on the same page (kimlyparc.com prints the panel only as an image: Serving size 1 Packet (20g), Calories 90). Label weight, per the bars-and-sticks convention (a stick wrapper is a gram or so). The page's 'net wt. 7 oz (250g)' box figure is the maker's own inconsistency (10 × 20 g = 200 g) and is not used.
